evidence.reason: `os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", default)` only uses `$HOME/.config` when the variable is unset. An empty value returns `""`, so `Path("") / "systemd/user"` becomes the relative path `systemd/user`; a relative override is likewise used directly. XDG base-directory semantics require unset, empty, or relative values to fall back to `$HOME/.config`, so this is an ordinary correctness defect in the live host layout.
